_comment: Synthetic replay fixture for the P4 HL7 v2 message subscription read-only connector PoC (R26). Segments, identifiers, names and ID numbers are all fabricated; the PID deliberately carries raw-looking identifiers/phone so tests can prove the PHI exit guard tokenizes them before the envelope is released. The third OBX is deliberately malformed (no code/value) to exercise the parse_warnings path. No real patient data may ever enter this file.
